title: mbox: parse_mbox_directory loads all messages into memory before processing — OOM for large archives
description: mbox.rs: parse_mbox_directory collects all MboxMessage (including raw: Vec<u8>) from all .mbox files into a single Vec before starting the import loop. For a multi-GB mbox archive this holds the entire archive in RAM simultaneously. The module docstring claims 'Streams messages without loading the entire file into memory' — true for the file reader, but parse_mbox_directory negates this by collecting all messages across all files. Should process and forward each message as it is parsed without collecting the full list.
